result:
All done. The RealWorld Hurl conformance suite now passes **13/13** against the live server.

## Root causes & fixes

The 12 failures traced to four spec gaps. All fixes are in `src/` (rebuilt to `dist/` and the server restarted), plus a Prisma schema/DB change.

**1. Resource-scoped error envelopes** (errors_articles, errors_auth, errors_authorization, errors_comments, errors_profiles) — the suite expects Rails-style `{errors:{<field>:[...]}}`, but the handler emitted `{errors:{body:[...]}}`. I gave `AppError` an overridable `errors` envelope (defaulting to `{body:[message]}`) and resource-scoped each throw site:
- missing/invalid token → `{token:["is missing"]}`
- not-found → `{<resource>:["not found"]}` (derived from the resource name)
- forbidden → `{article|comment:["forbidden"]}`
- duplicate → `{email|username:["has already been taken"]}`; bad login → `{credentials:["invalid"]}`
- empty `email`/`password`/`title`/`description`/`body` → `"can't be blank"` (was `"is invalid"` / prefixed)

**2. DELETE article/comment → 204** (favorites, feed, pagination, tags, comments) — controllers returned `200 {}`; now `204` with no body.

**3. Integer comment ids** (comments, articles.hurl assertions) — `Comment.id` was `String @default(uuid())`. Changed to `Int @default(autoincrement())` across the Prisma schema, domain port, both repositories, service, presenter, and controller (parses `:id` as an integer). Required `prisma generate` + `prisma db push`.

**4. Article `tagList` update + null rejection** (articles.hurl:225) — `{tagList:[]}` was stripped → empty update → 422. The update schema now accepts `tagList` (array clears tags, `null` → 422), threaded through to both repos.

**5. Nullable-field coercion** (auth.hurl) — empty-string `bio`/`image` on PUT `/api/user` now normalize to `null`.

## Verification
- **Hurl: 13/13 files, 149 requests pass** (confirmed twice, fresh `uid`).
- Pre-commit gate all green: `tsc --noEmit`, `eslint`, jest **211 passed**, coverage **98.9% stmts / 93.8% branch** (the 1 skipped suite is the real-DB Prisma test that auto-skips). Test files asserting the old contract (status 200, string ids) were updated to the new contract.

I left the rebuilt server running on `:3008`. I did not commit — the working tree (source, tests, `prisma/schema.prisma`) is ready for your review.
